limitations: Internal, non-authoritative regression evidence only; never a public assurance or sales artifact.
Not a certification or conformance statement.
Not an audit opinion or independent security assessment.
Not legal advice or evidence of legal or regulatory compliance.
Not operational uptime, availability, reachability, or hotline currency evidence.
Not an accessibility assessment, VPAT, ACR, or assistive-technology review.
Not a language qualification or evidence of completed qualified human review.
Not a penetration test, threat model, privacy assessment, or security attestation.
Static checks bind only the exact repository source bytes listed below.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Records the bound release changelog source consumed by repository release generation.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove deployed bytes, current service operation, or third-party delivery.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Manually review changed release semantics before accepting a refreshed source digest.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Records the bound dataset release registry used by deterministic repository checks.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not independently validate hotline accuracy, currency, reachability, or provider approval.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Manually review registry history and the generated candidate before any dataset release.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Implements the cited static release descriptor and artifact identity regression checks.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not establish signatures, hostile filesystem race freedom, or deployed artifact identity.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review implementation changes and rerun the complete release verification gate.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Implements the cited repeat-build comparison for the repository release artifact boundary.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not establish reproducibility on every platform, toolchain, or future dependency graph.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: A reviewer must assess toolchain changes and interpret any reproducibility delta.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Defines the bound multi-stage image build and the files copied into its static serving stage.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove a registry image, deployment configuration, runtime behavior, or availability.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Inspect every image-context or final-stage change and rerun the deployment image smoke test.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Defines the bound static route and response-header configuration used by the repository image.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove upstream TLS, infrastructure policy, live headers, or operational behavior.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: A qualified operator must separately review live infrastructure and observed responses.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Excludes the complete reviews directory from the bound Docker build context.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not by itself prove absence from local build output or every possible distribution path.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Keep reviews excluded and rerun dist and final-image nonpublication scans; other channels remain held.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Binds selected static accessibility regression assertions to its finite source inventory.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove WCAG conformance, legal compliance, or assistive-technology outcomes.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Qualified manual keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, zoom, reflow, RTL, and browser review remains required.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Documents the intended finite static accessibility boundary and its explicit limitations.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not constitute an accessibility assessment, certification, VPAT, ACR, or assessor opinion.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Commission and record a separately authorized qualified accessibility review before making any external statement.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Records the deterministic pending-only UI-string handoff for the bound locale and key inventory.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove translation quality, locale qualification, reviewer approval, or service accuracy.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Identity-distinct qualified human decisions require a future separately approved authenticated process.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Defines the closed structural contract for the bound pending-only multilingual review pack.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not establish semantic correctness or substitute for deterministic regeneration and human review.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review schema and generator parity whenever locale, key, classification, or status inventory changes.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Records the bound closed safety classification used to generate the UI review handoff.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not establish legal clearance, linguistic correctness, or suitability in a locale.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: A qualified reviewer must examine safety-facing copy and legal-sensitive copy needs separate legal clearance.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Documents the pending-only multilingual handoff boundary and reviewer instructions.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not qualify a locale or authorize canonical hotline, provider, or contact changes.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Qualification remains held until a separately approved authenticated reviewer-decision process exists.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Binds narrow static security and privacy repository assertions and gaps to exact source bytes.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove security or privacy compliance, penetration results, runtime controls, or operational response.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Qualified manual security and privacy review is required before interpreting or refreshing its bounded assertions.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Documents the finite internal inventory semantics, fail-closed mechanics, and known limitations.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not constitute a threat model, audit, legal opinion, attestation, or external assessment.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Independent assessment, penetration testing, runtime infrastructure, and provider practices remain separately unassessed.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Documents the bounded index contract, runtime-only invariants, and conservative nonpublication limitations.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not independently enforce the documented behavior or make the internal index authoritative.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review wording against the bound implementation whenever control semantics change.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Defines the exact checked-in Draft 2020-12 structural specification validated with Ajv 2020.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not express source ordering, exact cross-object coverage, byte reading, gap count, or assurance-language rules.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review schema and runtime-only tests together whenever either contract changes.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Pins the repository dependency graph containing the Ajv 2020 implementation used by this verifier.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not establish dependency security, provenance, future availability, or runtime correctness.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review dependency updates and rerun the bounded verifier tests after lockfile changes.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Defines the finite technical due-diligence scripts and verify-all wiring checked by the verifier.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove that a remote CI run executed or that external branch rules require it.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review script wiring changes and run the local targeted verification gate.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Prints refreshed source digests through the shared tracked stable-reader implementation.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not authorize a digest refresh or replace manual review of changed source meaning.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Use only after reviewing every intentionally changed bound control and evidence source.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Provides the inherited tracked no-follow reader and whole-index snapshot checks reused here.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not provide portable openat traversal, absolute race freedom, or hostile-concurrency safety.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Retain adversarial replacement, symlink, worktree drift, and index-mutation tests when changing it.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Implements schema loading, Ajv validation, runtime-only invariants, and exact source coverage checks.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not elevate bounded static repository facts into operational or external assurance.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review implementation and evidence language together before refreshing its digest.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Exercises accepted and rejected schema instances plus runtime-only and stable-reader adversarial cases.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not exhaust all filesystem interleavings, semantic interpretations, or future platform behavior.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Extend focused cases whenever schema, reader, or runtime-only invariants change.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Scans the locally built served root for finite due-diligence paths and stable marker strings.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not scan arbitrary marker-stripped copies or prove an externally deployed image identity.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Rerun with a container engine and inspect changes to the finite served-root probes.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Scans built distribution files for finite internal markers, exact current evidence-file hashes, recursive internal semantic subtrees, unique substantive scalar fingerprints, and normalized purpose-specific field-clearance tuples in JSON or raw text through a bounded fixed-point HTML/percent/JavaScript-escape decoder.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not detect arbitrary encryption, compression, or paraphrase, or inspect distribution channels outside its input tree.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review marker, tuple, and artifact coverage when adding or renaming internal evidence.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: Runs the checked-in schema, runtime, source, and package-script wiring verification entry point.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not show that any external CI system ran it or accepted its result.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Run the targeted verifier and inspect failures before any integration decision.

artifacts.proves_narrowly: The bound Web CI job invokes verify-all and the local deployment-image verifier without a job-level condition.
artifacts.does_not_prove: Does not prove any remote run completed or that repository branch protections require the job.
artifacts.next_qualified_or_manual_gate: Review CI wiring and separately inspect external required-check configuration.
